description: Say which release line of a runtime, container image, GitHub Action, or package to write today, instead of whatever training data remembers. Pass a product name such as node, python, or postgres, or a Package URL such as pkg:docker/library/node or pkg:githubactions/actions/checkout. Returns offing.recommend.v1: the recommended line and the date it is supported until, other qualifying alternatives, the lines to avoid with their dates, and evidence sources. A line qualifies when the data does not mark it ended and its end date is at least minimumSupportDays away (default 180). The answer comes only from Offing's bundled lifecycle data, never from the network, so it never says 'latest' and is limited to what the data covers. no-data means Offing has no data for the product, not that any version is safe. No repository is read.

as_of.description: Date the answer is for, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC); set it for a repeatable answer.

minimumSupportDays.description: Days a release line must stay supported to qualify. Defaults to 180.

product.description: A product name as lookup accepts it (node, python, postgres) or a Package URL without a version.

name: recommend_version

outputSchema.description: Which release line of a runtime, image, GitHub Action, or package to write today, answered from Offing's bundled lifecycle data only. It is limited to what the data covers and never names a version as the latest.

recommended.description: The release line to write, such as 22.

status.description: no-data means Offing has no lifecycle data for the product; it does not mean any version is safe.

outputSchema.title: Offing version recommendation v1

title: Recommend version
